senses.definition: In a direct manner; in a straight line or course.
senses.example: He drove directly to the office, and didn't stop off at the petrol station.

senses.definition: In a straightforward way; without anything intervening; not by secondary but by direct means.
senses.example: I'm sick of asking you to fire him; I'll just do it directly.

senses.definition: Plainly, without circumlocution or ambiguity; absolutely; in express terms.
senses.example: I'm going to tell Natalie directly that I love her.

senses.definition: Exactly; just; at the shortest possible distance.

senses.example: He told me directly that he'd cheated on me, and how sorry he was for it.

senses.definition: Soon; next; in due time; as soon as it becomes convenient.
senses.example: We'll go to the store directly, but first I need to finish sweeping.

senses.definition: As soon as; immediately (elliptical for directly that/as/when)
senses.example: “He is, he is," Nastenka repeated. “He is here, and I know it. We made an agreement at the time, that evening, before he went away: when we said all that I have told you, and had come to an understanding, then we came out here for a walk on this embankment. It was ten o'clock; we sat on this seat. I was not crying then; it was sweet to me to hear what he said.... And he said that he would come to us directly he arrived, and if I did not refuse him, then we would tell grandmother about it all. Now he is here, I know it, and yet he does not come!"
